scope: After breadth only: typed equivalence consumer; no current source implementation.

cases.name: positive_zero
cases.test: All contracts accept identity t=0.

cases.name: passive_nonzero
cases.test: Accept exact S congruence only with full fields transported.

cases.name: wrong_t
cases.test: Reject H parameter inconsistent with S.

cases.name: wrong_inverse
cases.test: Reject forward matrix substituted for inverse.

cases.name: freeze_gamma
cases.test: Reject passive observable receipt with old gamma.

cases.name: freeze_spinor
cases.test: Reject old field components after passive basis change.

cases.name: freeze_adjoint
cases.test: Reject fixed-K adjoint test applied to H-transported gamma.

cases.name: omit_derivative
cases.test: Reject variable S connection without S inverse dS.

cases.name: wrong_connection_sign
cases.test: Reject negative inhomogeneous correction.

cases.name: active_phi
cases.test: Accept epsilon right gauge with bare Phi fixed and dressed Phi conjugated.

cases.name: wrong_epsilon_side
cases.test: Reject epsilon left multiplication when the contract specifies right action.

cases.name: metric_group
cases.test: Reject non-K-unitary passive S labeled active fixed-K gauge.

cases.name: pair_abs_parameter
cases.test: Reject |s|≠|t| simultaneous fixed-K pair congruence.

cases.name: pair_sign_flip
cases.test: Accept source gamma7 pointwise sign flip under full U(K).

cases.name: fixed_W_sign_flip
cases.test: Reject the same gamma7 when W must remain fixed.

cases.name: fixed_gamma_adjoint
cases.test: Reject nonzero t with unchanged canonical negative-adjoint gamma.

cases.name: source_field_presence
cases.test: Refuse physical-modulus conclusion without H as a source field.

cases.name: global_patch
cases.test: Reject pointwise-only certificate advertised as global; alternatively bind global K,W plus smooth flipper construction.

cases.name: finite_allreal
cases.test: Refuse all-real claim from rational checks without universal coefficient/projection argument.

cases.name: action_complete
cases.test: Require each source action term, base metric/Hodge/epsilon/A0 and coupling convention bound before unchanged-action claim.
